response.original_title: ¿Por qué Fernando Garrido se tragó un destornillador mirando a Toni mientras sonreía?
response.overview: The second short film by Iván Chaves, a student at the Complutense University's Faculty of Information Sciences and a member of its InfoRadio multimedia lab. Its long title asks why Fernando Garrido swallowed a screwdriver while looking at Toni and smiling.
response.title: ¿Por qué Fernando Garrido se tragó un destornillador mirando a Toni mientras sonreía?
